name: Masked rise
description: Motion library (brand-kit aware): Each word rises out of its own line on the beat it is spoken, an accent rule draws under the last one.

sample.subtitle: For the first time in 1,200 years

name: Cinematic track-in
description: Motion library (brand-kit aware): Letters drift together from wide tracking and soft focus - a slow, filmic title for an opening or a reveal.

name: Split lines
description: Motion library (brand-kit aware): Two lines slide in from opposite sides and meet on a divider that draws out from the centre.

name: 3D flip-up
description: Motion library (brand-kit aware): Words hinge up from below in 3D, one after another, and settle flat with a soft shadow.

name: Focus pull
description: Motion library (brand-kit aware): The whole line comes into focus as the camera pulls back a touch - for a quiet, heavy statement.

sample.text: It was never about the money

name: Bar sweep reveal
description: Motion library (brand-kit aware): An accent bar sweeps across each line and leaves the words behind it - a news-desk reveal, line by line.

name: Spoken words
description: Motion library (brand-kit aware): The line is set faintly, and each word lights up in the accent exactly as it is said.

sample.text: Every single drop was already promised

name: Kit title card
description: Motion library (brand-kit aware): A full-screen card on the kit's ground: a huge condensed title in the accent, built word by word, a quiet sub line.

name: Pull quote
description: Motion library (brand-kit aware): A large serif quotation mark settles, the words follow in italic, the speaker's name tracks in under them.

sample.text: We had no idea how bad it was
sample.subtitle: Former site engineer

name: Open question
description: Motion library (brand-kit aware): The question writes itself in word by word; the last word and its question mark land in the accent with a soft glow.

sample.text: So where did it all go?

name: Accent bar
description: Motion library (brand-kit aware): A thin accent bar grows, the name slides out from behind it, the role fades up underneath.

name: Frosted card
description: Motion library (brand-kit aware): A frosted glass card slides in low on the calm side carrying the name and role; the edge catches the accent.

name: Tag and name
description: Motion library (brand-kit aware): A pill tag in the kit colours wipes on, then the name rises beside it - for a place, a date or a category.

name: Underline
description: Motion library (brand-kit aware): Minimal: the name fades up out of soft focus and an accent line draws under it from the left.

name: Two-tone blocks
description: Motion library (brand-kit aware): Two solid blocks slide in one after the other - the label in the accent, the name in white - and lock together.

name: Place marker
description: Motion library (brand-kit aware): A map-pin ring pulses once, the place name tracks in beside it and the coordinates type on in mono.

name: Source credit
description: Motion library (brand-kit aware): A small, quiet credit in the corner - a short rule, SOURCE in caps, the name - for footage and figures.

name: Hero figure
description: Motion library (brand-kit aware): A big figure counts up on the beat it is said, its unit tracks in in small caps under it, a rule draws on.

name: Kit figure card
description: Motion library (brand-kit aware): A full-screen card on the kit's ground: the figure huge in the number colour, what it is of in the accent.

name: Percent ring
description: Motion library (brand-kit aware): A ring draws round to the percentage as the figure counts to it inside - for any share, rate or chance.

sample.text: of the river is used up

name: Unit grid
description: Motion library (brand-kit aware): A 10 x 10 grid settles in, then the share fills cell by cell from the bottom in the accent - a percentage you can see.

sample.text: of the climbs reach the summit

name: Year roll
description: Motion library (brand-kit aware): The year rolls up through the decades and lands on its word; a hairline and the event settle under it.

name: Then and now
description: Motion library (brand-kit aware): Two figures side by side: the first lands, the second counts past it in the accent, a divider between them.

name: Drawn circle
description: Motion library (brand-kit aware): A hand-drawn ring circles the thing on screen as it is named, with a label pill riding beside it.

name: Curved arrow
description: Motion library (brand-kit aware): A curved arrow draws from a short label to the point on screen, its head snapping in at the end.

name: Marker highlight
description: Motion library (brand-kit aware): A line on the footage; the key word gets a marker block swept behind it in the accent as it is said.

name: Focus brackets
description: Motion library (brand-kit aware): Four corner brackets close in on a spot like a camera locking focus, then a small label types under it.

name: Spotlight
description: Motion library (brand-kit aware): Everything but one spot dims slowly, so the eye goes where the narrator points; a soft label settles by it.

name: Statement with rule
description: Motion library (brand-kit aware): A short statement on the footage: an accent rule draws first, then the words slide off it, the key word in the accent.

name: Name tiles
description: Motion library (brand-kit aware): Two to five names arrive as tiles one after another under a short header - organisations, places, products.

name: Panel sweep
description: Motion library (brand-kit aware): A full-height accent panel sweeps across the cut with motion blur, a darker panel close behind it.

name: Staggered bars
description: Motion library (brand-kit aware): Five vertical bars in the kit colours drop in one after another to cover the cut, then lift away.

name: Iris
description: Motion library (brand-kit aware): A soft disc in the kit ground grows from the centre to swallow the shot, then opens out onto the next.

name: Chapter wipe
description: Motion library (brand-kit aware): The kit ground wipes across the cut carrying a chapter title; it holds a beat, then wipes off onto the next shot.

name: Light sweep
description: Motion library (brand-kit aware): A warm band of light rakes across the cut in screen blend - a soft, filmic way between two shots.

name: Word stack slam
description: Motion library pack 2 (brand-kit aware): A justified block of stacked words, every line set to the same width in tight heavy caps; each line rises out of its own mask on its spoken word and the stack settles a hair as it lands. Use: A punchy hook or a three-to-six word verdict said with force ("they lost everything"); the hook and big turns only.

name: Split reveal
description: Motion library pack 2 (brand-kit aware): One big line cut through the middle: its top half slides in from one side, its bottom half from the other, and they lock together on a bright accent seam. Use: A short line that turns the story ("everything changed", a name reveal); one line, at most five words.

name: Spoken mask wipe
description: Motion library pack 2 (brand-kit aware): A mask wipes big heavy words on left to right in step with the voice, line by line; an accent rule and an optional sub line settle under the last word. Use: A full sentence worth reading along (a thesis, the stakes); lines up to about 8 words, any section.

sample.text: The deal that built a city

name: 3D card flip
description: Motion library pack 2 (brand-kit aware): An accent card with a short setup turns over in 3D on the spoken word and shows the answer on its back. Use: A setup and its answer (kicker = the setup, e.g. "The cause"; text = the reveal); question-then-answer moments.

name: Extruded 3D title
description: Motion library pack 2 (brand-kit aware): A monumental title in tight heavy caps with a shallow, dark extrusion: the words rise on their spoken beats, the block settles from a gentle 3D angle and keeps turning slowly; an accent rule draws out under it. Use: An episode / topic title or a name that deserves a monument ("Burj Khalifa", "The Great Fire"); one to four words, openings and chapter starts.

name: Declassified
description: Motion library pack 2 (brand-kit aware): A typed paper slip with every word blacked out; each bar pulls away the moment its word is spoken. Use: A secret, a leak, a hidden fact or a document quote coming out ("the report admitted..."); crime, history, politics, business.

name: Bar race
description: Motion library pack 2 (brand-kit aware): Horizontal bars grow on their spoken names, figures counting along, then re-sort themselves into rank order. Use: Three to six things compared by one figure (countries, companies, players); items as "Name 41" in the narration's order.

name: Line draw-on
description: Motion library pack 2 (brand-kit aware): A trend line draws itself point by point under a soft fill; the last point pulses and a callout lands with its figure. Use: A figure changing over time (rose, fell, doubled, grew since...); items as "2010 4.2" (period then figure), three to eight points.

name: Donut build
description: Motion library pack 2 (brand-kit aware): A donut builds slice by slice on the spoken parts; the first slice pops out and its share counts up in the middle. Use: A whole split into two to five parts (shares, budgets, sources); items as "Coal 36%", the part the line is about first.

name: Stat grid
description: Motion library pack 2 (brand-kit aware): Two to four glass tiles rise in turn, each figure counting up over its label, a kit-accent rule drawing across its top. Use: Several figures said close together (a scorecard: cost, time, people, distance); items as "Workers 3,000" - two to four.

name: Timeline scrubber
description: Motion library pack 2 (brand-kit aware): A track draws across, then a playhead scrubs from date to date as each is spoken, lighting it and its caption. Use: Three to six dated events in order (a history, a career, a build); items as "1872 First park" - the date first.

name: Ranking ladder
description: Motion library pack 2 (brand-kit aware): A top-five ladder that fills from the bottom rung up; number one lands last, in the accent, with a glow. Use: A countdown or a top list ("the five biggest...", "number one is..."); items #1 first ("Tokyo 37" or just names), up to six.

name: Before / after slider
description: Motion library pack 2 (brand-kit aware): A slider handle sweeps across the shot: one side turns into an old black-and-white print, the other stays as it is now, labelled. Use: Then versus now, before versus after, old versus new over one shot (items = the two labels, e.g. "1950", "Today").

sample.text: The same street, seventy years apart

name: Magnifier focus
description: Motion library pack 2 (brand-kit aware): A magnifying glass glides onto one point of the shot as it is named: everything else blurs and dims, the lens stays crisp and richer. Use: Pointing at a detail the viewer must find in the picture (a crack, a face in a crowd, a line on a map); give point when known.

name: Sticky note
description: Motion library pack 2 (brand-kit aware): A sticky note in a light tint of the kit accent slaps onto the frame and the words write themselves in by hand. Use: A reminder, a takeaway or a to-do the narrator states ("remember this", "rule number one"); up to about 10 words.

name: Polaroid drop
description: Motion library pack 2 (brand-kit aware): A polaroid frame tumbles onto the shot and the moment inside it develops from white, a handwritten caption underneath. Use: Freezing a moment as a memory (a person, a place, a year: "summer 1969"); caption up to four words.

name: Document zoom
description: Motion library pack 2 (brand-kit aware): A typed page settles into the frame with its quoted line set large in the middle; an accent marker sweeps under each word as it is read while the camera pushes in on the line. Use: Quoting a report, a letter, a ruling, a contract or a study (the narrator reads its line); kicker = the source, sub = a date.

name: Quote card with portrait
description: Motion library pack 2 (brand-kit aware): An editorial pull quote: a big accent quotation mark, the words set large in italic as they are said, then the speaker's name in tracked caps and their role under a short accent rule. Use: Someone's own words quoted in the narration with the speaker named (sub = speaker, kicker = their role); up to about 20 words.

sample.text: We did not know the river could rise that fast
sample.subtitle: Maria Lopez
sample.label: Resident

name: Social post
description: Motion library pack 2 (brand-kit aware): A clean social post card settles in, its words set large and lighting from a ghost grey as they are read; then the heart fills (and the likes count up, when they are said). Use: A post, tweet or comment the narration quotes (sub = the account's name, kicker = a date, value = likes only when said).

sample.text: This is the worst traffic I have ever seen in this city
sample.subtitle: Daniel Reyes
sample.label: 2h

name: Phone messages
description: Motion library pack 2 (brand-kit aware): A phone settles into frame at a slight 3D angle and a chat plays out on it from the bottom up, typing dots first, each bubble rising in on its time. Use: Texts, DMs or messages the narration reads out (items = the messages in order, sub = the contact's name); one to four short messages.

name: Browser window
description: Motion library pack 2 (brand-kit aware): A browser window rises with its address typing in; the headline appears and a marker sweeps under it as it is read. Use: A headline, article, website or search result the narration cites (kicker = the site, sub = a section or date; text = the headline as said).

sample.text: Record heat closes schools across the region
sample.subtitle: Breaking
sample.label: dailynews.com

name: Scribble loop
description: Motion library pack 2 (brand-kit aware): A fast marker scribble loops twice round the point as it is named, a handwritten note riding beside it. Use: Circling something on screen in a loose, human way (a person, a car, a building); point when known, text = two or three words.

name: Brush swoosh
description: Motion library pack 2 (brand-kit aware): The line sets in large and a tapered brush stroke in the accent sweeps under it as its last word lands. Use: A short line with a strong final word ("and it worked", "completely free"); up to six words, any section.

name: Loop arrow
description: Motion library pack 2 (brand-kit aware): A handwritten note, then a marker arrow that loops once on its way to the point on screen, its head snapping on. Use: Naming something on screen with a bit of personality ("the original", "still there today"); point when known, two to four words.

name: Countdown ring
description: Motion library pack 2 (brand-kit aware): A ring drains in steps while the figure in it ticks down; the last steps pulse and the ring flashes at zero. Use: A countdown, a deadline or time running out ("ten seconds", "three days left"); value = the starting figure said, text = its unit.

name: Fact-check stamp
description: Motion library pack 2 (brand-kit aware): The claim sets in large as a quote, word by word; on the verdict a solid badge hits beside it - red for false (the claim is struck through and dims), green for true, the accent otherwise. Use: A claim being checked, a myth busted or confirmed (text = the claim as said; kicker = the verdict word said: False, Myth, True...).

sample.text: You only use ten percent of your brain
sample.label: Myth

name: Strike and correct
description: Motion library pack 2 (brand-kit aware): The wrong words are set in big heavy caps, a hard marker bar strikes them through and they dim; the correction then rises in above them, just as big, in the accent. Use: Correcting a belief or a figure ("not 10 million - 30 million", "it wasn't an accident"); text = the struck words, sub = the correction, both as said.

name: Ink bleed
description: Motion library pack 2 (brand-kit aware): Ink in the kit's deep colour blooms in from near one edge, its feathered edge led by a thin accent rim, until the shot is covered; the next shot bleeds through from the other side. Use: A soft, artful change of place or time (a memory, a new chapter of a life story); calm or emotional sections.

name: Film burn
description: Motion library pack 2 (brand-kit aware): A warm light leak: a skewed band of film light sweeps across with a corner glow and gate streaks, flashing warm white for a moment over the cut, then cools away onto the next shot. Use: A jump in time or a flashback ("years earlier", "back in 1985"), archive and nostalgic footage, emotional peaks.

name: Glitch slices
description: Motion library pack 2 (brand-kit aware): A digital signal tear made of the shot itself: torn bands of the picture blow out with red / cyan channel fringes and compression blocks as it builds, a two-frame signal drop with one bright scan line hides the cut, and it clears fast onto the next shot. Use: Tech, hacking, internet, breaking news, a sudden twist or a system failing; energetic sections, never in calm ones.

name: Paper tear
description: Motion library pack 2 (brand-kit aware): A grained sheet in the kit colour, its torn edges ragged with a white fibrous core, slides across at a slight tilt, covering the cut and tearing away onto the next shot. Use: Moving to a new topic or case in an explainer, scrapbook or history piece; playful or documentary.

name: Block dissolve
description: Motion library pack 2 (brand-kit aware): A directional tile wipe in the kit's ground tones: tiles grow in as the wave reaches them, its front lit in the accent, cover the cut, then shrink away in the same direction onto the next shot. Use: A modern, data or tech change of section (a new list item, a new chapter in an explainer).
